set.body: Implement PRD RA-8: MarkSelector[K] as typed serializable data with RequireUnique/First/Last/Nth occurrence, EpochPlan with Window and PositiveSpan bin width, and FinalBin RequireExactDivision/IncludeShortFinal/ExcludeAndReport. Missing or ambiguous anchors name trial, selector and match count; excluded tails are returned as data. No closure-valued predicate and no silent final-bin truncation.
set.title: Serializable epoch selectors and final-bin policies
